MAKE EVERY SET USEFUL

Solve. Explain. Check again.

  1. Solve independently. Use the assigned timer and calculator rules. Write the setup before calculating.
  2. Find the first wrong step. Record whether the issue was the concept, algebra, reading, units or time.
  3. Retest the skill. Use your linked retest or instructor-selected practice, and explain why the corrected method works.
